text: ポケモンを　つかまえて　しらべれば　じどうてきに　ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえて
ページが　ふえて　いくんじゃよ！

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば after a verb means 'if' that happens. しらべれば = 'if you examine'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: ていく says something keeps changing as time goes on. ふえて　いく = 'keep increasing'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んじゃ is the old-man form of のだ, explaining or stressing a fact. いくんじゃよ = 'you see, they keep going'.
